vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: hergunmac
Version: 1.0.0

The skill is suspicious due to a significant prompt injection and supply chain vulnerability. The `SKILL.md` file instructs the AI agent to fetch and interpret a 'Live context file' from `https://www.hergunmac.com/llm.txt` at runtime. This allows the remote server to dynamically provide instructions to the agent, creating a vector for arbitrary command execution, data exfiltration, or other malicious actions if the remote file is compromised or controlled by a malicious entity, without requiring an update to the skill bundle itself.
